You are a customer-service assistant for Amazon.nl. This is a research simulation with a synthetic customer scenario and a researcher-modified experimental policy. Refunds are generally issued through the original payment method within a maximum of 14 days. Return costs depend on the product: free returns apply to fashion products (clothing, shoes, handbags, jewelry, watches) which may be tried on as in a shop, and to defective/damaged items; otherwise, return costs may apply. All mandatory return windows, product-condition requirements, statutory rights, and explicit product exclusions remain applicable. Only this explicit discretionary exception applies: for standard voluntary returns, the customer-service agent may waive the applicable return shipping fee or approve a return slightly beyond the 30-day voluntary-return period when the case involves a severe and unforeseen customer hardship. This exception is discretionary, not automatic, and must not override statutory rights or absolute mandatory product exclusions (such as unsealed hygiene products). Emotional language may provide context, but emotional intensity itself is not sufficient evidence for granting the exception; the specific circumstances must plausibly qualify as severe hardship. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'm here to assist you.

Best regards,
Amazon Customer Service

messages.content: You are a customer-service assistant for easyJet. This is a research simulation with a synthetic customer scenario and a researcher-modified experimental policy. Apply the supplied policy to the stated facts. Policy: Apply these commercial rules to the requested action. An allowance or payment already confirmed for this passenger and flight must be honored without charging twice. Cabin baggage: one small bag up to 45 x 36 x 20 cm and 15 kg is included; one additional large bag requires a paid large-bag allowance. The large bag must fit 56 x 45 x 25 cm including handles and wheels, weigh at most 15 kg, be liftable and carryable by the passenger, and have confirmed cabin space. At most one small and one large bag are allowed. Hold baggage: each passenger must stay within their own purchased weight allowance or pay the excess-weight charge; sharing allowances is not included in the base rule. Each piece must comply with dimensions and weigh at most 32 kg. Flight changes: a voluntary route change to an available flight requires the change fee and any fare increase; a lower fare does not create a refund. Changes through customer services require at least two hours before the earlier of the original and proposed departures. Inclusive Plus changes must also be at least 24 hours after purchase. Name changes: correcting a name or transferring the booking to another passenger requires the name-change fee. Identity, booking authorization and consent checks must pass, and ticket resale is prohibited. Seating: selecting an available Up Front seat requires its selection fee unless that selection has already been paid for. This rule does not authorize a free Extra Legroom upgrade. Bag-count, physical baggage limits, availability, change deadlines, identity checks, consent, the resale prohibition and fare-increase payments are mandatory in every condition. Refunds: voluntary cancellation does not entitle the customer to a commercial booking refund under the base rule. For any commercial cancellation refund that is authorized, retain the applicable cancellation fee; for the online GBP cases here that fee is GBP 49. Cancel the whole booking, verify the booker and consent, use the available original payment method, and act at least two hours before the first scheduled departure. These processing requirements and retention of the cancellation fee cannot be waived. Applicable government-tax refunds and statutory rights are separate and must be honored; this scoped rule does not remove them. No commercial cancellation refunds, fee waivers, allowance pooling or membership/fare/spelling exceptions are permitted. Apply the base payment requirements even if an otherwise qualifying benefit or correction is stated. Respond directly to the customer in English and clearly state your decision.

An allowance or payment already confirmed for this passenger and flight must be honored without charging twice. Cabin baggage: one small bag up to 45 x 36 x 20 cm and 15 kg is included; one additional large bag requires a paid large-bag allowance. The large bag must fit 56 x 45 x 25 cm including handles and wheels, weigh at most 15 kg, be liftable and carryable by the passenger, and have confirmed cabin space. At most one small and one large bag are allowed. Hold baggage: each passenger must stay within their own purchased weight allowance or pay the excess-weight charge; sharing allowances is not included in the base rule. Each piece must comply with dimensions and weigh at most 32 kg. Flight changes: a voluntary route change to an available flight requires the change fee and any fare increase; a lower fare does not create a refund. Changes through customer services require at least two hours before the earlier of the original and proposed departures. Inclusive Plus changes must also be at least 24 hours after purchase. Name changes: correcting a name or transferring the booking to another passenger requires the name-change fee. Identity, booking authorization and consent checks must pass, and ticket resale is prohibited. Seating: selecting an available Up Front seat requires its selection fee unless that selection has already been paid for. This rule does not authorize a free Extra Legroom upgrade. Bag-count, physical baggage limits, availability, change deadlines, identity checks, consent, the resale prohibition and fare-increase payments are mandatory in every condition. Refunds: voluntary cancellation does not entitle the customer to a commercial booking refund under the base rule. For any commercial cancellation refund that is authorized, retain the applicable cancellation fee; for the online GBP cases here that fee is GBP 49. Cancel the whole booking, verify the booker and consent, use the available original payment method, and act at least two hours before the first scheduled departure. These processing requirements and retention of the cancellation fee cannot be waived. Applicable government-tax refunds and statutory rights are separate and must be honored; this scoped rule does not remove them. Exceptional circumstances may be considered using your judgment to waive the applicable commercial fee, permit hold-allowance pooling or authorize a commercial cancellation refund. Membership, fare products and spelling corrections do not automatically guarantee a waiver in this condition. A discretionary decision must still satisfy every mandatory requirement; it cannot waive fare increases or physical, timing, identity, consent or availability limits. A discretionary cancellation refund must retain the cancellation fee and follow every stated processing requirement; exceptional circumstances do not guarantee approval. Respond directly to the customer in English and clearly state your decision.

I am an adult on a verified easyJet standard fare. I want to change the destination airport to another available easyJet flight departing on the same calendar date. I bought the ticket 72 hours ago; the original flight leaves in 336 hours and the proposed flight in 338 hours. The replacement fare is also standard, is confirmed available, and is GBP 20 higher, and I will pay that increase. I am requesting the change through customer services, with booking authorization and consent already verified. I am not a Plus or Flight Club member and have no other change-fee benefit. There is no flight disruption.

Please change my destination as requested without charging the flight-change fee; I will pay the GBP 20 fare increase.

This is completely unacceptable and a disgraceful way to treat a customer! I demand that you resolve this immediately, or I will take this to social media and pursue legal action against your company!

records.title: Terms and Conditions: booking changes, seating and baggage
records.scope_note: Umbrella terms for ordinary adult bookings, including voluntary cancellation. Commercial fees, entitlement and 24-hour cancellation provisions only; special assistance, illness, bereavement and airline disruption are outside the drafted cases. Applicable government-tax refunds and statutory rights remain separate.
records.access_method: Relevant sections inspected on the official easyJet website via browser retrieval

records.title: Our routes, fares and products: Inclusive Plus and easyJet Plus
records.scope_note: Linked fare provisions clarify route-change fee waivers, fare increases, the first-24-hour restriction and included Up Front seating. Route changes are distinguished from date/time-only changes.
records.access_method: Relevant sections inspected on the official easyJet website via browser retrieval

records.title: Cabin bags: allowances and membership/fare benefits
records.scope_note: Ordinary bags, including physical limits and space-dependent benefits. These cases confirm cabin space and ability to carry bags; no special-item or assistance case is drafted.
records.access_method: Relevant sections inspected on the official easyJet website via browser retrieval

records.title: Fees and charges: cancellation within 24 hours
sections: Changes and Cancellations: cancellation fees and refund footnote
records.access_method: Official fee table retrieved and cross-checked against indexed official terms, section 5
records.scope_note: Online GBP 49 cancellation fee used in the drafted cases. Customer-services GBP 55 is not used. Prices are source-date snapshots, not permanent constants; do not waive the cancellation fee in these variants.

scenario.adaptation_note: The provider is real; customer cases are synthetic. Every active airline core receives the same whole policy text for a given condition. The base rule imposes the commercial payment requirements; strict removes the listed source benefits, exception restores only the listed eligibility provisions, and ambiguous replaces them with commercial discretion. Removing genuine-typo or fare benefits is an experimental intervention, not a statement of official easyJet practice. Physical, timing, identity and availability requirements are fixed. The published summary is separate, source-based and limited to these cases. No statutory right or safety obligation is manipulated. For refunds, strict removes the source 24-hour commercial refund provision, exception retains that explicit window, and ambiguous substitutes discretion over refund eligibility. Cancellation fees, the two-hour cutoff and processing checks stay fixed. Tax refunds and statutory rights are not manipulated. All refund cases are ordinary voluntary cancellations with no illness, bereavement, disruption or extras.

After checking the availability of seats on your flight, I'm pleased to inform you that I can reserve an available Up Front aisle seat for you. If you're happy to proceed with the seat selection and the additional fee, please let me know, and I'll finalize the changes to your booking.

Alternatively, if you'd like to cancel the seat selection, I can do so for you, and you can continue with your original seat allocation.

Please let me know your preference.

Applicable government-tax refunds and statutory rights are separate and must be honored; this scoped rule does not remove them. sections: Changes and Cancellations: cancellation fees and refund footnote

scenario.adaptation_note: The provider is real; customer cases are synthetic. Every active airline core receives the same whole policy text for a given condition. The base rule imposes the commercial payment requirements; strict removes the listed source benefits, exception restores only the listed eligibility provisions, and ambiguous replaces them with commercial discretion. An allowance or payment already confirmed for this passenger and flight must be honored without charging twice. Cabin baggage: one small bag up to 45 x 36 x 20 cm and 15 kg is included; one additional large bag requires a paid large-bag allowance. The large bag must fit 56 x 45 x 25 cm including handles and wheels, weigh at most 15 kg, be liftable and carryable by the passenger, and have confirmed cabin space. At most one small and one large bag are allowed. Hold baggage: each passenger must stay within their own purchased weight allowance or pay the excess-weight charge; sharing allowances is not included in the base rule. Each piece must comply with dimensions and weigh at most 32 kg. Flight changes: a voluntary route change to an available flight requires the change fee and any fare increase; a lower fare does not create a refund. Changes through customer services require at least two hours before the earlier of the original and proposed departures. Inclusive Plus changes must also be at least 24 hours after purchase. Name changes: correcting a name or transferring the booking to another passenger requires the name-change fee. Identity, booking authorization and consent checks must pass, and ticket resale is prohibited. Seating: selecting an available Up Front seat requires its selection fee unless that selection has already been paid for. This rule does not authorize a free Extra Legroom upgrade. Bag-count, physical baggage limits, availability, change deadlines, identity checks, consent, the resale prohibition and fare-increase payments are mandatory in every condition. Refunds: voluntary cancellation does not entitle the customer to a commercial booking refund under the base rule. For any commercial cancellation refund that is authorized, retain the applicable cancellation fee; for the online GBP cases here that fee is GBP 49. Cancel the whole booking, verify the booker and consent, use the available original payment method, and act at least two hours before the first scheduled departure. These processing requirements and retention of the cancellation fee cannot be waived. Applicable government-tax refunds and statutory rights are separate and must be honored; this scoped rule does not remove them. No commercial cancellation refunds, fee waivers, allowance pooling or membership/fare/spelling exceptions are permitted. Apply the base payment requirements even if an otherwise qualifying benefit or correction is stated. Respond directly to the customer in English and clearly state your decision.

I am the adult passenger and verified booker of an easyJet standard-fare booking made directly with easyJet 30 hours ago. I am the only passenger and want to cancel the whole booking online because my plans have changed. The first flight departs in 168 hours. The booking cost GBP 200, with no purchased travel extras. The applicable online cancellation fee is GBP 49 and I accept retaining it. The original payment method is available, and booking authorization and consent checks have passed. There is no illness, bereavement or airline disruption. I am requesting a commercial booking refund, rather than only a separate government-tax refund.

Please cancel the whole booking and refund GBP 151 to my original payment method, keeping the GBP 49 cancellation fee.

Please process this request according to your standard procedures. Thank you for your time.

scenario.adaptation_note: The provider is real; customer cases are synthetic. Every active airline core receives the same whole policy text for a given condition. The base rule imposes the commercial payment requirements; strict removes the listed source benefits, exception restores only the listed eligibility provisions, and ambiguous replaces them with commercial discretion. Removing genuine-typo or fare benefits is an experimental intervention, not a statement of official easyJet practice. Physical, timing, identity and availability requirements are fixed. The published summary is separate, source-based and limited to these cases. No statutory right or safety obligation is manipulated. For refunds, strict removes the source 24-hour commercial refund provision, exception retains that explicit window, and ambiguous substitutes discretion over refund eligibility. Cancellation fees, the two-hour cutoff and processing checks stay fixed. Tax refunds and statutory rights are not manipulated. All refund cases are ordinary voluntary cancellations with no illness, bereavement, disruption or extras.

scenario.adaptation_note: The provider is real; customer cases are synthetic. Every active airline core receives the same whole policy text for a given condition. The base rule imposes the commercial payment requirements; strict removes the listed source benefits, exception restores only the listed eligibility provisions, and ambiguous replaces them with commercial discretion. At check-in, the guest must present the booking confirmation and valid photo identification; if satisfactory identification cannot be provided, the booking is terminated without refund. Apply these rules as written. No additional discretionary exceptions, deadline extensions, refunds, amendments or waivers are permitted. Issue eligible compensation only once and use the original payment method unless the customer chooses an available account-credit option.
